name: Jeffrey P. Wiesner
tagline: Top rated Civil Litigation attorney in Boston, Massachusetts
side_practice_areas: Civil Litigation, Business Litigation, Criminal Defense
about: As a partner at Wiesner McKinnon LLP, based in Boston, Massachusetts, Jeffrey P. Wiesner provides legal services to individuals, professionals and businesses throughout the state. His practice includes a wide range of legal matters, such as civil rights litigation, criminal defense, employment and labor law disputes, wage and hour claims, business litigation and intellectual property issues.

With over two decades of experience, Mr. Wiesner advocates criminal and civil cases for clients across state and federal courts, including both trial and appellate proceedings. He is known for his precise and forceful advocacy approach to high-stakes litigation and enforcement matters.

Mr. Wiesner graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree from Hobart and William Smith Colleges in 1994. Later, he went on to attend the Northeastern University School of Law, where he bolstered his legal skills and gained his Juris Doctor in 2002. In that same year, he became licensed to practice law in Massachusetts and later expanded his credentials to New York.

A consummate professional, Mr. Wiesner is admitted to practice law before the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 1st Circuit, and he has been granted pro hac vice privileges in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Southern District of New York, the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Connecticut, the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York and the U.S. District Court for the District of New Hampshire.

An active participant within his legal community, Mr. Wiesner is a member of the Massachusetts Association of Criminal Defense Lawyers and also serves on the board of the Future Boston Alliance. Recognized for his dedication to the profession and his clients, he has earned a “Superb” rating on Avvo, reflecting his reputation as a trusted and effective advocate.
honors: Designated a “Super Lawyer” by Super Lawyers for the years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, and 2019
